title: Design a Module's Public API
prompt:
Write a module object for a cart library. Define `createCart()` that returns an object exposing exactly three methods — `add(item)`, `total()`, `clear()` — and NO direct access to the items array.

`add` accepts `{ name, price }` and returns the new item count. `total()` returns the sum of prices. `clear()` empties the cart.

tests.name: add returns the running count
tests.hint: Keep items in a closure variable; return items.length after pushing.

tests.name: total sums prices
tests.hint: reduce over the closed-over items array.

tests.name: items array stays private
tests.hint: Only the three methods belong on the returned object.

tests.name: clear resets count and total
tests.hint: clear can reassign the closure variable to a fresh array.
